title: Jordan denies US claim of Aqaba airport and seaport evacuation over security threat
summary: Jordan has denied a US claim that it had ordered the evacuation of its Aqaba airport and seaport due to a security threat. The denial comes amid heightened tensions between Jordan and the United States over issues related to regional security. The incident highlights the complexities of international relations in the Middle East, where multiple countries are involved in competing interests and security concerns.
summary_points: Jordan has denied a US claim about evacuating its Aqaba airport and seaport
The denial comes amid heightened tensions between Jordan and the United States

The incident highlights the complexities of international relations
